title: Team rules
summary: What everyone agrees to before using Tasks, Chat and News, and how reports and blocks work.

blocks.text: The first time you open Team you are shown the Team rules. Tap **I agree** to start. If the rules change you are asked again.

items: There is zero tolerance for objectionable content or abusive behaviour.
Managers review every report within 24 hours, remove what breaks the rules, and the person who posted it can lose access.
Report a chat message from its menu (long-press in the app), a task from its menu, or a comment from its ⋮.
Block someone from your direct message with them. In team chats their messages fold away, and search leaves them out.
